newsitem.title: USA: Ronson Corp Q4 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Ronson Corp Q4 net loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Net income for the fourth quarter of 1995 included a deferred income tax benefit of $294,000.
Loss from continuing operations in the fourth quarter of 1996 included a deferred income tax benefit of $89,000.
Net loss for the fiscal year 1996 included a non-recurring charge of $434,000 for a reduction in inventory and restructuring costs at Ronson Aviation and a deferred income tax benefit of $210,000.
Net income for the fiscal year 1995 included a deferred income tax benefit of $576,000 and proceeds of an insurance claim of $96,000.

Loss from discontinued operations included a charge of $1,190,000, net of deferred income tax benefits of $180,000, in the fourth quarter of 1996 and $860,000, net of deferred income tax benefits of $110,000, in the fourth quarter of 1995. Losses from discontinued operations were related to environmental compliance costs and the sale of Prometcor Inc.
Net income was calculated before the payment of preferred dividends, earnings per share were calculated after the payment of preferred dividends.
The company paid $176,000 to preferred shareholders in 1996 as compared to $178,000 in 1995.
